scripts.db:migrate: tsc src/db/migrate.ts --outDir .next/db-cli --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop && node .next/db-cli/db/migrate.js && rm -rf .next/db-cli
scripts.db:seed: tsc src/db/seed.ts --outDir .next/db-cli --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop && node .next/db-cli/db/seed.js && rm -rf .next/db-cli
scripts.db:reset: tsc src/db/seed.ts --outDir .next/db-cli --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop && node .next/db-cli/db/seed.js --reset && rm -rf .next/db-cli
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.desktop:prod: npm run desktop:build && cross-env NODE_ENV=production DESKTOP_MODE=production electron .next/desktop/main.js
scripts.test: tsc --rootDir . src/engine/__tests__/matchEngine.test.ts src/components/match-viewer/__tests__/matchVisualizer.test.ts src/db/__tests__/persistence.test.ts src/db/__tests__/sqlitePersistence.test.ts desktop/__tests__/desktopLauncher.test.ts --outDir .next/test-dist --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --esModuleInterop && node --test .next/test-dist/src/engine/__tests__/matchEngine.test.js .next/test-dist/src/components/match-viewer/__tests__/matchVisualizer.test.js .next/test-dist/src/db/__tests__/persistence.test.js .next/test-dist/src/db/__tests__/sqlitePersistence.test.js .next/test-dist/desktop/__tests__/desktopLauncher.test.js && rm -rf .next/test-dist
